same_scene.instructions: `shot_a` and `shot_b` describe two consecutive shots from the film Finch. Both shots belong to the same continuous scene: the same location and the same ongoing situation, without a jump to another place or another time.

same_place.instructions: `shot_a` and `shot_b` describe two consecutive shots from the film Finch. Both shots are in the same place (the same room or building, the same vehicle interior, or the same outdoor area).

same_daytime.instructions: `shot_a` and `shot_b` describe two consecutive shots from the film Finch. Both shots have the same time of day and weather (for example both at night, or both in the same sandstorm).
